For any question: {seller.email}.

These terms of sale apply to the sale, on this website, of the services offered under the name {brand} by {seller.name} (the “Seller”) to any person, whether acting as a consumer or for the purposes of their business (the “Client”):

  • personal coaching for creating websites, video ads and motion design with artificial intelligence (the “I guide you” option, hereafter the “personal exchange”);
  • the making by the Seller, for the Client, of a video ad, a motion design video or, with the “Studio” and “Pro” options, a website, offered in three options: “Studio”, “Pro” and “Essential” (hereafter the “made-to-order creation”).

Placing an order means accepting them. Specific provisions for business clients are set out in clause 12.

2.1 The personal exchange (“I guide you”). The personal exchange is a short, one-to-one written coaching service, delivered by email or, if the Client chooses so when ordering, by direct message on TikTok. Based on the information provided by the Client when ordering and paying (type of project, reply channel, reply language, description of their project and, where applicable, TikTok handle), the Seller personally writes a tailored answer including:

  • explanations of the Seller’s method for creating with artificial intelligence, applied to the Client’s project (website, video ad, motion design or a similar project);
  • the tools the Seller uses, and those suited to the Client’s level;
  • advice on how to phrase requests to AI;
  • {prompts} example prompts tailored to the Client’s project.

The Client may then ask follow-up questions by replying to that message ({followUps}) within {followUpDays} days of that answer; the Seller replies once.

The personal exchange does not include making the Client’s website, video or animation, a full training course, a subscription, or support by phone or video call. Its price is the price of the exchange, not of a finished production. The Seller has an obligation of means: no specific result is guaranteed.

2.2 The made-to-order creation (“Studio”, “Pro” and “Essential” options). Based on the description of their project, which the Client provides when ordering or by email afterwards, and on any material they send if they wish (logo, copy, images, examples), the Seller personally makes, using artificial intelligence tools, as chosen by the Client, a video ad or a motion design video, delivered as video file(s), or, with the Studio and Pro options only, a website, delivered as files and put online by the Seller. Its content depends on the option chosen:

  • Studio: a video lasting up to {tiers.studio.videoSeconds} seconds, which may include several scenes, with voice-over and subtitles, three variants of the video’s opening, in vertical, square and landscape formats, or a scrolling website with 3D effects, in several sections; {tiers.studio.revisions}; delivery at the latest {tiers.studio.deliveryHours} hours after payment is confirmed.
  • Pro: a video lasting 20 to {tiers.pro.videoSeconds} seconds, with voice-over and subtitles, in vertical and square formats, or a custom animated web page made for phones, after an email exchange about the project if needed; {tiers.pro.revisions}; delivery at the latest {tiers.pro.deliveryHours} hours after payment is confirmed.
  • Essential: a video lasting up to {tiers.essentielle.videoSeconds} seconds, in vertical format, made from the description provided by the Client, without prior exchange; {tiers.essentielle.revisions}; delivery at the latest {tiers.essentielle.deliveryHours} hours after payment is confirmed.

Each revision may be requested within {revisionDays} days of delivery and covers adjusting details of the delivered creation (copy, colours, pacing). A revision does not cover a change of project.

For a website, the Seller puts it online on a free third-party hosting service, at the address provided by that service, and gives the Client its files, so the Client can host it elsewhere at any time. A domain name is not included: if the Client wants one, they buy it in their own name.

The made-to-order creation does not include a website with the Essential option, an online shop, a multi-page website or maintaining a website after delivery (quoted separately), buying advertising space or managing campaigns, filming, or a subscription.

If the Client’s request goes beyond this scope, or cannot be carried out (in particular if it is unlawful or infringes a third party’s rights), the Seller tells the Client before starting and refunds the order in full.

The videos and websites shown on the website are examples of the Seller’s own work. The creation delivered depends on the Client’s request and on the format described above. The Seller does not guarantee the results the Client expects from their creation (audience, sales, search ranking).

The total price of the personal exchange is {pricesRegular.guide}. The total prices of the made-to-order creation are {pricesRegular.studio} for the Studio option, {pricesRegular.pro} for the Pro option and {pricesRegular.essentielle} for the Essential option. As part of the launch offer, the Essential option is offered at {launch.price} for any order placed until {launch.until} (Paris time). Each price is payable once. {seller.vat}.

The applicable price is the one shown on the website and on the payment page when the order is placed.

There is no subscription and no recurring payment.

The Client orders from the website: they choose their option, review the summary, specify their type of project and, for the personal exchange, their preferred reply channel (email or TikTok), expressly ask for the service to begin (article 6), then are redirected to Stripe’s secure payment page. There, they give their email address and, depending on the option, their language, the type or a description of their project and their TikTok handle.

Payment is made using one of the methods offered on the Stripe payment page (card, Apple Pay, Klarna, Amazon Pay, etc.). Payment details are processed exclusively by Stripe and, where applicable, by the provider of the chosen payment method: the Seller never has access to them. When a payment method confirms with a delay, the order is only confirmed once the payment has actually been received.

The contract is concluded as soon as Stripe confirms the payment. The Client receives a payment receipt by email, then the Seller emails them the order confirmation before starting the service.

Personal exchange. The Seller sends their answer as quickly as possible, and at the latest within {delay} of Stripe confirming the payment. It is sent by email, from {seller.email}, to the email address used for payment, or, if the Client chose TikTok and gave their handle, by direct message on TikTok. If that direct message cannot be delivered (missing or wrong handle, messages not allowed), the answer is sent by email.

Made-to-order creation. The Seller delivers the creation as quickly as possible, and at the latest within the time set for the chosen option in clause 2.2, from Stripe confirming the payment. It is delivered by email, from {seller.email}, to the email address used for payment, as attached files or a download link; for a website, that email also gives the address where it is online. If the Seller cannot deliver within that time, they inform the Client, who may cancel the order and receive a full refund.

The services are only performed once Stripe has confirmed the payment. A thank-you page displayed on the website does not count as payment confirmation.

If the project description is missing or not enough, the Seller asks the Client for it; the time limit then runs from the Client’s reply. Likewise, when the Client says they will send material to be included in their creation, the delivery time runs from its receipt.

The Client agrees to provide accurate information and to check their spam folder and, if they chose TikTok, their message requests.

Under article L221-18 of the French Consumer Code, the Client has fourteen days from the conclusion of the contract to withdraw, without having to give a reason.

When ordering, the Client expressly asks for the service to begin before the end of that period (article L221-25). If the Client withdraws after the service has begun, they pay an amount proportionate to the service provided until they communicate their decision to withdraw.

Under article L221-28, 1°, the right of withdrawal can no longer be exercised once the service has been fully performed, the Client having given prior express consent to its beginning and acknowledged that they would lose their right of withdrawal once the service has been fully performed.

The service is fully performed once the Seller’s answer has been sent in full (personal exchange) or once the creation has been delivered (made-to-order creation).

To exercise this right, the Client sends the Seller, before the period expires, an unambiguous statement (for example by email to {seller.email}) or the form below. The refund is made no later than fourteen days after that decision is received (article L221-24), using the same means of payment.

Withdrawal form

To {seller.name}, {seller.address}, {seller.email}:

I hereby give notice that I withdraw from my contract for the provision of the following service:

Ordered on: …
Name of consumer: …
Address of consumer: …
Signature of consumer (only if this form is notified on paper): …
Date: …

Advice and examples are provided as guidance. The Client remains solely responsible for how they use them, and for choosing and using third-party tools and services (terms, availability, pricing), over which the Seller has no control.

For the made-to-order creation, the Client warrants that they hold the necessary rights to the material they send (copy, images, logos, trademarks) and that their request is lawful. The Client remains solely responsible for how they use the delivered creation, and for putting it online and distributing it.

Personal exchange. The content delivered to the Client (answer, prompts, explanations) is intended for their personal use and their own projects. Reselling it or publishing it as is requires the Seller’s permission.

Made-to-order creation. Once the creation has been paid for and delivered, the Client may freely use, reproduce, distribute and modify it, for personal or professional purposes, including commercial ones, in any medium, worldwide and for the full term of protection of the rights. The Seller does not publish or reuse the creation without the Client’s consent. Any third-party elements included (fonts, music, images, content produced by artificial intelligence tools) remain subject to their publishers’ terms.
The Client’s data is processed in accordance with the privacy policy.
For any complaint, the Client first contacts the Seller in writing at {seller.email}. The Seller endeavours to reply as soon as possible.
sections.ifMediator: If the complaint is not resolved, the Client may refer it free of charge to the consumer mediator the Seller belongs to: {mediator.name}, {mediator.url}.
sections.ifNoMediator: The Client may also use conventional mediation or any other alternative dispute resolution method.

These terms are governed by French law. This choice does not deprive a Client living in another country of the protection granted by the mandatory provisions of that country’s law.

These terms are available in French and English. In case of discrepancy, the French version prevails.

These terms also apply to a Client ordering for the purposes of their business (the “Business Client”), subject to the following provisions, which prevail for them:

  • the right of withdrawal (clause 6) and recourse to a consumer mediator (clause 10) are reserved for consumer Clients, except where the law extends them to certain professionals (article L221-3 of the French Consumer Code);
  • the price is payable in full when ordering; no discount is granted for early payment. Any late payment would automatically incur penalties at the interest rate applied by the European Central Bank to its most recent refinancing operation plus 10 percentage points, and a fixed recovery fee of €40 (articles L441-10 and D441-5 of the French Commercial Code);
  • an invoice is sent to the Business Client on simple request to {seller.email}, stating the name and address of their business. {seller.vat};
  • the Seller’s liability towards a Business Client is limited to direct and foreseeable damage, up to the price paid for the order concerned;
  • the Business Client warrants that the person placing the order is authorised to bind their business.
{seller.name}, {seller.address}. Contact: {seller.email}.

• At payment, on Stripe’s secure page: email address, name, country and payment information, along with your reply language, your project description and, if you wish, your TikTok handle. I never have access to card numbers.
  • Our email exchanges: the content of our messages and, for a made-to-order creation, the material you send me (logo, copy, images, examples).
  • Technical data: connection logs kept by the host for the website’s security.

• Providing the personal exchange or the creation you ordered, and contacting you about it: performance of the contract (article 6.1.b GDPR).
  • Handling payments, accounting and legal obligations: legal obligation (article 6.1.c).
  • Keeping the website secure: legitimate interest (article 6.1.f).

Your data is never sold or used for advertising.

Your data is intended for me. It is processed on my behalf by technical providers: Stripe (payment) and, where applicable, the provider of the payment method you choose (for example Klarna or Amazon Pay), Cloudflare (website hosting), Postmark (sending the automatic order confirmation email) and my email provider. If you choose to get my reply on TikTok, it is sent through TikTok’s direct messages.

Some of these providers may process data outside the European Union. Such transfers are then covered by appropriate safeguards (adequacy decision or the European Commission’s standard contractual clauses).

• Order data (form, emails, material you sent): for the duration of the service, then {seller.retention} at most.
  • Accounting records: 10 years, as required by article L123-22 of the French Commercial Code.

You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, object to and port your data. To exercise these rights, email {seller.email}.

You can also lodge a complaint with the CNIL, the French data protection authority (cnil.fr).

This website uses no advertising cookies and no audience measurement tools. It only stores, in your browser, what it needs to work: the language you chose, the option you chose before paying and, if you arrive from TikTok, the fact that you closed the welcome screen.

The website’s font is loaded from Google Fonts: your browser therefore sends your IP address to Google.

On its payment page, Stripe may set its own cookies, which are needed to secure the payment.
